title: Cleaning and Damage Fees: Evidence Requirements by Fee Level
content:
For Cleaning and Damage Fees, each fee level sets how many photos a driver's report must have on file before it can be reviewed, what those photos must show, whether a receipt or estimate must also be on file, which documents count as that receipt, and how many evidence submissions the driver may make on one report.

| Fee level | Photos on file before review | What the photos must show | Receipt or estimate on file before review | Documents accepted as the receipt | Most evidence submissions per report |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | 2 | a close-up of the affected area | No | none | 2 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | 3 | a close-up of the affected area; the affected area in context | No | none | 2 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | 3 | a close-up of the affected area; the affected area in context | No | none | 2 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | 4 | a close-up of the affected area; the affected area in context; each affected surface | Yes | a cleaning receipt | 3 |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | 3 | a close-up of the damaged component; the damaged component in context | Yes | a repair receipt or a repair estimate | 3 |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | 4 | a close-up of the damaged component; the damaged component in context; the vehicle plate | Yes | a repair receipt or a repair estimate | 3 |

## Questions drivers ask about this table

**Which levels need a document as well as photos?**
Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major), which takes a cleaning receipt, and both damage levels, which take a repair receipt or a repair estimate. At Levels 1 to 3 no document is required.

**Does a repair estimate count as the receipt at the damage levels?**
Yes. Damage Fee (Interior Repair) and Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) both accept a repair receipt or a repair estimate as the document on file.

**How many times can evidence be sent in on one report?**
Twice at Cleaning Fee Levels 1, 2 and 3, and three times at Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) and at both damage levels. Each upload of photos and each document sent counts as one submission.

**What must appear in the photos at Damage Fee (Exterior Repair)?**
A close-up of the damaged component, the damaged component in context, and the vehicle plate — at least four photos in all.
